ONE FIGURE ON THE LOG: a small bundled figure sitting on a mossy log with their back to us, shoulders rounded, turned toward the low crackling fire
ONE FIGURE ON THE STONE: a tiny figure perched on a flat stone with their back to us, knees drawn up, facing the warm amber glow
ONE FIGURE IN THE BLANKET: a small hooded figure wrapped in a blanket on a log with their back to us, leaning gently toward the fire
ONE FIGURE WITH THE MUG: a small figure sitting on a low log with their back to us, both hands curled around a warm mug, turned toward the flames
ONE FIGURE AT THE EMBER GLOW: a tiny bundled figure seated on a round stone with their back to us, still and quiet, facing the dying ember light
TWO FIGURES AT THE FIRE: two small figures sitting side by side with their backs to us, a clear gap between them, both turned toward the warm fire
TWO FIGURES AT THE WATER: two tiny figures standing side by side with their backs to us, a gap between them, both looking out toward the lantern-lit water
TWO FIGURES ON THE LOG: two small bundled figures on a long log with their backs to us, shoulders apart, both turned toward the low campfire glow
TWO FIGURES IN THE FIELD: two tiny figures standing side by side with their backs to us, a clear space between them, both facing the distant fire light
DOG BY THE FIRE: a small dog curled tight on the warm ground beside the fire, nose tucked under its tail, resting in the amber heat
DOG AT THE EDGE: a tiny dog sitting alert at the far edge of the warm ground, ears up, watching the tree line beyond the fire light
DOG ON THE GRASS: a small dog curled in the grass just inside the ring of firelight, its sides rising and falling slowly in the warmth
DOG WATCHING THE FLAMES: a tiny dog sitting upright near the fire with its back to us, ears forward, eyes fixed on the shifting flames
DEER AT THE TREE LINE: a small deer standing still at the far tree line, ears up, watching the warm fire light from the dark edge of the wood
DEER IN THE SHADOW: a tiny deer paused at the far boundary of the trees, head raised, eyes catching the faint glow of the distant fire
DEER AMONG THE PINES: a small deer standing motionless between the far pines, turned toward the warm amber light, ears wide and still
OWL ON THE POST: a small owl perched on a wooden post at the edge of the light, round and still, looking out over the warm fire glow
OWL ON THE BRANCH: a tiny owl sitting on a low branch above the fire ring, feathers puffed, watching the warm ground below with calm eyes
OWL ON THE RAIL: a small owl settled on a far wooden rail, outlined against the dark sky, facing the soft lantern light across the grass
CAT ON THE STONE: a small cat sitting upright on a flat stone at the edge of the firelight, tail curled around its paws, eyes on the glow
CAT AT THE LIGHT'S EDGE: a tiny cat perched on a mossy stone where the warm light fades, perfectly still, watching the fire from the border of the dark
FOX IN THE FAR GRASS: a small fox crossing the far grass at the edge of the firelight, one paw raised mid-step, moving through the amber shadow
FOX AT THE MEADOW EDGE: a tiny fox picking its way across the far meadow grass, body low, passing through the outermost reach of the warm glow
FIGURE IN THE BOAT WITH LANTERN: a small figure in a tiny boat with their back to us, leaning forward to tend the hanging lantern above the dark water
FIGURE TENDING THE BOAT LANTERN: a tiny figure seated in a far boat with their back to us, hands raised toward the lantern, its warm light pooling on the still water
